prompt.v: ABCD is a trapezoid with AB ∥ DC. M and N are the midpoints of AD and BC. AB = 10 and DC = 4. How long is MN?

problems.text: trapezoid midsegment: AB 10, DC 4; find MN
problems.explain: AB ∥ DC, and M and N are the midpoints of AD and BC. The midsegment of a trapezoid is parallel to the bases and halfway between them, so its length is their average: (10 + 4) ÷ 2 = 7. (Half of one base, or their difference, leaves the other base out.) So MN = 7.

problems.explain: AB ∥ DC, and M and N are the midpoints of AD and BC. The midsegment of a trapezoid is parallel to the bases and halfway between them, so its length is their average: (13 + 9) ÷ 2 = 11. (Half of one base, or their difference, leaves the other base out.) So MN = 11.

prompt.v: ABCD is a trapezoid with AB ∥ DC. M and N are the midpoints of AD and BC. AB = 13 and MN = 11. How long is DC?

problems.text: trapezoid midsegment: AB 13, MN 11; find DC
